supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: pronounced extension laterally beyond the outer eye corner

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: the muzzle and lower chin regions are significantly lighter in pixel intensity compared to the deep dark pigments of the cheek and periocular regions

pinna_silhouette.severe_cartilage_deformities: distinct notched irregularities and missing segments along the superior and posterior sections of the helix

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: structural cartilage notches present on the ear helix
